content:
Here are the ideal conditions for Apple tree seed growth:

• Temperature: 18-24°C
• Hydrometry: 50-70%
• Sunshine: 6-8 hours
• Rainfall: 750-1000 mm
• Humidity: 60-70%
• Soil pH: 6.0-7.0
• Soil type: Loamy sandy

Note: These are general guidelines and can vary slightly depending on specific apple variety and local climate conditions.
